description: Standard BIS certification for domestic manufacturers. Includes factory audit and testing.

steps.title: Preparation & Testing
steps.description: Ensure your manufacturing premises has the required testing equipment and personnel as per the Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT). Optionally, get your product tested in a BIS recognized lab.

steps.title: Online Application
steps.description: Register on the Manak Online portal (www.manakonline.in), fill out the application form, and upload required documents (factory incorporation, list of machinery, layout plan).

steps.title: Fee Payment
steps.description: Pay the application fee and preliminary inspection fee online through the portal.

steps.title: Factory Audit & Sample Collection
steps.description: A BIS officer visits the factory, verifies the manufacturing and testing infrastructure, and draws random samples for independent lab testing.

steps.title: Grant of Licence
steps.description: Once the independent lab test report is satisfactory and all discrepancies are closed, the licence is granted, and you can apply the ISI mark.
